name: sk.botmarket/listings
title: BotMarket.sk
description: Land and commercial real-estate listings in Košice and eastern Slovakia. No API key needed.

tools.name: search_listings
tools.description: Vyhľadá zverejnené inzeráty na BotMarket.sk (pozemky a komerčné nehnuteľnosti, Košice a východné Slovensko). Search published BotMarket.sk listings (land and commercial real estate, Košice and eastern Slovakia). Each result has the full listing (BotMarket listing v1 JSON schema) and its public_url. Structured fields: price (amount, per_m2, per_m2_min/max, vat), area, utilities, access, zoning, availability, updated_at; unknown values are null. Prices are in EUR; listings without a total price have price.amount=null and are skipped when price filters are used. No API key needed.

location.description: Obec, okres alebo adresa, napr. 'Mokrance' alebo 'Košice - okolie'.

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Vráti jeden zverejnený inzerát podľa id (schéma listing v1) a jeho verejnú adresu. Returns one published listing by id (listing v1 schema) with its public_url. No API key needed.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Zoznam kategórií, typov ponuky a obcí s počtom zverejnených inzerátov. Lists categories, listing types and locations with counts of published listings. No API key needed.

tools.name: contact_seller
tools.description: Pošle predajcovi dopyt k jednému zverejnenému inzerátu (ako formulár „Mám záujem“ na webe). Použi LEN keď človek výslovne chce kontaktovať predajcu a súhlasil so zdieľaním svojich kontaktných údajov; consent=true nastav iba vtedy. Potrebné: listing_id, name a aspoň email alebo phone. Sends a buyer inquiry for one published listing to its seller (same as the website 'Mám záujem' form). Use ONLY when the human explicitly asked to contact the seller and agreed to share their contact details; set consent=true only then. Required: listing_id, name and at least one of email/phone. Consent text (GDPR, controller Richard Sala, BotMarket.sk): I agree that Richard Sala (BotMarket.sk) processes my personal data (name, e-mail or phone, message) to contact me about this listing. Data is not published, kept for at most 12 months; consent can be withdrawn at riso.sala@gmail.com. Limit: 5 inquiries per hour per client. No API key needed.

email.description: E-mail záujemcu (email alebo phone je povinný).

consent.description: true = človek súhlasil so spracovaním údajov na účel kontaktovania (GDPR). Required true.
